headline: Commission to discuss Community Pool Program Fees and honoring former Parks & Recreation Director Stanley Shepardson.
summary: The commission will discuss Community Pool Program Fees and consider honoring former Parks & Recreation Director Stanley Shepardson. It will also receive director and project reports, including an update on Community Pool Park.
